comparison_policy: Use the previous daily_path as the next run baseline. Do not claim no-change when product-level fields were not previously comparable. Search-cache-only observations are baseline or SOURCE_FRESHNESS_LIMITED, not same-day change.
offline_policy: Never delete a known product when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with the last confirmed date.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and manufacturer product code when available.
